slices.title: Per-run ceiling, 80/100% warnings, optional enforcement
slices.summary: Adds RunCeiling resolution (request cap wins, org limits fill unset, token cap counts metered tokens only, subscription exempt) with the warnings run_ceiling_80 and run_ceiling_reached, each emitted once per run and attached to usage_progress. With MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CEILING_ENFORCE on, the tool phase ends before the next round once the ceiling is reached and the answer still streams; the meter shows a ceiling bar.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib run_ceiling budget org_quota
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CEILING_WARN (default false, then true after S4); MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CEILING_ENFORCE (default false)

slices.title: Proofs, ZDR matrix rows and ownership docs
slices.summary: Adds workspace-tools-proof.sh and agent-action-admission-proof.sh, modelled on tickets-create-proof.sh with a disposable Postgres and no credential creation. Adds the ZDR posture-matrix rows workspace_tools_under_zdr_not_offered_not_executed, owner_actions_under_zdr_not_offered and owner_reads_under_zdr_not_offered with their vendored copies, adds the workspace_tools refusal key, records the ledger and capability-ownership rows, and makes CI run the two new contract tests. Proofs run only on rebuilt images, with flags flipped on the proof stack only.

slices.title: Attested, approval-gated provider writes (code half)
slices.summary: Grants model-execution integration:write in the Control Plane principal registry, then makes provider writes approval-gated with an attested, single-use approval: the approval shows recipient and subject only, provider_effect_summary is stored only in approvals.reason and erased with the run (K3-16), and writes bind to the turn scope and acting user. No write ships before the K1-11 ADR and the forged and replayed attestation tests.
slices.remaining: Code half: Attested, approval-gated provider write path behind its switch, tested with dev-only ephemeral keys.
